name: Escape the Tomb
description: Find the Secret Stairway tile that leads out of the dungeon before Strahd defeats you.

objectives.description: A Hero must start their turn on the Secret Stairway tile.

specialRules.description: Whenever a white arrow tile is explored, advance the Sun token. At Sunset (6 spaces), Count Strahd awakens on the Crypt bone pile.

introText: You wake up alone in the depths of Castle Ravenloft and must escape before the sun sets and Strahd returns.
victoryText: You have found the Secret Stairway and escaped the tomb! With the cool night air in your face, you leave the horrors behind... for now.
defeatText: The sun has set, and Strahd's dark power overwhelmed you. The tomb has become your final resting place.
